minimum_condition: claim_count >= 1
evidence_item_count >= 1
control_count >= 1
standard_owner_role_count >= 8
localized_owner_assignment_count >= 1 and executive/operational backup named
dated_control_test_count >= 1
recorded_access_test_count >= 1 for protected/excluded user paths
localized_audit_or_redress_count >= 1
closed_corrective_action_count > 0 when corrective actions exist
contract_instance_count >= 1 when delivery depends on contracts/grants
workforce_role_count >= 1
materiality_record_count >= 1
publication controls exist for assurance and sensitive resources
regulator-visible nuclear safety case and safety management evidence
site evaluation covers future climate, seismic, flood, drought, heat, wildfire smoke and external hazards
cooling water, water rights, thermal discharge and drought/heat derating are evaluated
spent fuel and waste custody, funding and storage/disposal responsibilities are explicit
protective action plan is tested for language access, disability access, carless households and dependent-care settings
security and cyber-physical protection controls are assigned and tested
cost, schedule, licensing, construction and change-order evidence is public enough for audit
contracting and ratepayer/taxpayer risk allocation are traceable and challengeable
fuel availability, enrichment/fabrication dependencies, supply chain and strategic risks are explicit
operator, construction, regulator and emergency workforce depth is credentialed and not single-point fragile
host-community engagement, public challenge, tribal consultation where applicable and language access are documented
risk counterarguments have support/qualify/refute evidence status and closure owner
